name: WISPDMX
summary: A search for lower-mass hidden photons using multiple radio-frequency cavity modes and broadband reception.
detection_principle: Dark-photon kinetic mixing generates weak electromagnetic signals in the cavity; four tunable resonant modes and nonresonant spectra simultaneously constrain different mass ranges.

key_parameters.name: First dataset
key_parameters.value: Approximately 61 h; 500 MHz bandwidth; 50 Hz resolution

results.summary: No credible dark-matter candidate; resonant and broadband kinetic-mixing upper limits were obtained.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
